verdict.rationale: HelixDB supports self-hosted/embedded/local deployment modes (memory, disk, object storage) and states 'all deployment options use the same queries and SDK tooling,' which lets a user physically control where data lives by choosing their own infrastructure, but there is no explicit region-selection feature or data-residency guarantee documented for Helix Cloud itself (e.g., no --region flag in `helix database create`, no residency/compliance statement). Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection UI or flag for the managed Cloud offering, and any documentation of residency guarantees or compliance certifications.
